fields.name: template_digest

fields.name: segmenter_id
fields.description: Registered executable core component responsible for segmentation and shipped with an exact Urdira engine version. A model pack may reference this identity and provide declarative inputs but cannot supply its implementation.

fields.name: segmenter_version
fields.description: Exact component version whose definition contains a compatible `embedding_segmenter` contract binding.

fields.name: configuration_digest
fields.description: Same embedded `embedding_profile_id` and `runtime_role = segmenter`; component coordinates equal the segmentation contract and matching runtime requirement.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: `explicit` or `all_text`.

fields.name: language_ids
fields.description: Non-empty registered set exactly for explicit mode; empty for all-text mode.

fields.name: supports_unclassified_text
fields.description: Whether text with no registered language classification may be segmented and embedded.

fields.name: manifest_schema_version
fields.description: Positive core bootstrap-schema version used to decode and validate the complete closed manifest before any asset is opened. Unknown versions are rejected; fields from another version are never ignored.

fields.name: model_pack_id
fields.description: Stable canonical namespaced pack identifier whose uniqueness is enforced within an installation. It conveys no authenticated publisher ownership.

fields.name: model_pack_version
fields.description: Exact normalized SemVer 2.0.0 version permanently bound to one canonical manifest digest. Build metadata is preserved as part of the exact coordinate even though SemVer precedence ignores it.

fields.name: embedding_profiles
fields.description: Non-empty duplicate-free ordered set of complete `EmbeddingProfile` definitions, canonically ordered by `embedding_profile_id`. Each stored `profile_digest` is recomputed before installation may continue.

fields.name: assets
fields.description: Non-empty complete ordered set of `ModelPackAssetEntry` values. Every declared entry is mandatory and canonical ordering follows the asset-entry contract below.

fields.name: required_runtime_components
fields.description: Non-empty complete ordered set of `ModelPackRuntimeRequirement` values needed to render, segment, generate, and infer for every embedded profile. Requirements can only select components already shipped with the target Urdira engine.

fields.name: manifest_digest
fields.description: Digest of exactly the six preceding fields under `core:model_pack_manifest_digest`; the digest field itself and all delivery metadata are omitted. Urdira recomputes it before collision checks or asset acquisition.

fields.name: content_digest

fields.description: Time physical deletion began after the reader barrier.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: Successful terminal completion time.

fields.name: workspace_boundaries
fields.description: Exact safe boundary evaluated for every participating workspace.

fields.name: retention_root_digest
fields.description: Scalar `input(ordered_set(core:RetentionRootReference@1, core:retention_root_order@1))`.

fields.name: candidate_object_count
fields.description: Exact number of objects marked pending deletion.

fields.name: candidate_object_digest
fields.description: Scalar `input(ordered_set(core:StoredObjectReference@1, core:stored_object_order@1))`; count equals `candidate_object_count`.

fields.name: deleted_object_count
fields.description: Exact objects physically deleted after sweep, present after sweep.

fields.name: deleted_object_digest
fields.description: Scalar `input(ordered_set(core:StoredObjectReference@1, core:stored_object_order@1))`; present exactly with `deleted_object_count`.

fields.name: failure_code
fields.description: Registered failure cause when the epoch has not completed successfully.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.description: Workspace evaluated during mark.

fields.name: current_generation
fields.description: Current generation captured at the mark barrier.

fields.name: minimum_retained_generation
fields.description: Conservative lowest generation reachable from workspace-local roots.
